column1: # G-C's ledger (scripts/origins-diff-rustc.sh documents the columns): every twin whose Yo and rustc verdicts differ.
# An unexplained divergence fails the job; so does a row here whose verdicts now agree.

column5: declared origins are rigid: `(mut(ra) : &(i32, x))` and `(mut(rb) : &(i32, y))` name two origins and `swap` needs one (E0923); rustc unifies both references to one region that both `x` and `y` outlive

decision 28's two-phase extension (P9) applies to every `&mut` argument: the loan `h` ends at its last use, the second argument's `*h.r`, before the call activates `&mut xs`; rustc grants two-phase borrows only to autoref receivers, so an explicit `&mut xs` argument conflicts with the earlier read
